summary: Release candidate 0.4.0 is ready as a local source handoff for the build.sh web launcher. The Python package builds, packaged web assets are current, release readiness and secret scan pass, and the launcher is documented as the easiest source UI start path.
build_artifacts: appforge/resources/web/index.html plus appforge/resources/web/assets/index-Bto0ykgx.js and index-C_67LZJ9.css from npm --prefix frontend run build
.appforge/reports/sbom.cdx.json generated by AppForge generate_sbom with root-manifest component count 0
install_and_run: Manual source setup remains available: python -m venv .venv; source .venv/bin/activate; python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'; npm --prefix frontend install; npm --prefix frontend run build; appforge web
Wheel run path remains available after installing dist/openappforge-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl with its dependencies: appforge web
Optional bridge path from source: APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge ./build.sh, or run llm_bridge separately with Bun and then appforge web
configuration: APPFORGE_WEB_HOST controls build.sh/appforge web bind host and defaults to 127.0.0.1.
APPFORGE_WEB_PORT controls build.sh/appforge web bind port and defaults to 8787.
APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 reuses current packaged web assets.
APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE=1 or APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge requests launcher-owned bridge reuse/startup.
APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE=1 leaves bridge management to another process.
APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_URL defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8788 for bridge health/proxy behavior.
APPFORGE_SMOKE_TIMEOUT and APPFORGE_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT bound launcher health polling.
migrations: No database or persistent data migration is required.
Existing appforge web, appforge-web, appforge forge/run/status/prompt/complete, frontend dev, and llm_bridge commands remain available.
AppForge Python quality command detection now uses sys.executable so required run_tests/run_build gates execute in the active interpreter even when python is not on PATH.

release_checks.evidence: .venv/bin/python -m appforge tool run run_build --project . --input '{}' returned success and built dist/openappforge-0.4.0.tar.gz plus dist/openappforge-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl.
shasum -a 256 reported ff941e4447bf868feb30f7a6f5eca9afb8ce8a751b0a3cd6e12944fdddeb7908 for the wheel and ccf2be726d212cd2fff55fba020b129e4edd0ef76f7d7c2ea829b2d6930faaef for the sdist.
.venv/bin/python -m appforge tool run secret_scan --project . --input '{}' returned success with findings=[].
release_readiness returned passed=true with source_present, README.md, .gitignore, verification artifact, and security artifact checks passing.
artifact_inventory found dist/, README.md, LICENSE, and CHANGELOG.md; detected stack is Python/FastAPI with pyproject.toml.
generate_sbom returned success and wrote .appforge/reports/sbom.cdx.json; current AppForge SBOM generation reports root-manifest component count 0.
Verification ran APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 APPFORGE_WEB_PORT=8799 ./build.sh --smoke successfully and cleaned up pid 17492.
Verification ran .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q with 24 passed, npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, npm --prefix frontend run build, AppForge run_tests, and AppForge run_build successfully.

known_issues: First-run dependency downloads and online dependency audit were not exercised because the AppForge runner has network downloads disabled; prepared-workspace skip behavior and deterministic local checks passed.
generate_sbom currently inventories root manifests only and does not enumerate nested frontend or llm_bridge npm dependencies.

Setuptools emits existing project.license/classifier deprecation warnings during python -m build; build still succeeds, but license metadata should be modernized before the 2027-Feb-18 setuptools deadline.
Launcher-owned llm_bridge startup was not tested against live provider credentials; bridge operation still depends on Bun, bridge dependencies, and user/provider configuration.
rollback: Stop any running launcher/web process with Ctrl-C.
Revert build.sh plus README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md edits to remove the launcher UX.
Revert appforge/tooling/detection.py and tests/test_tools.py if rolling back the AppForge quality-gate detector fix.
Continue using manual appforge web startup documented in README.md.
Rebuild packaged frontend assets with npm --prefix frontend run build if frontend assets are ever changed during rollback.
